Some of the beneficiaries affected by sections 101, 102, 103, 401, and 404 are veterans who have been exposed to environmental hazards, and CBO expects that some of the costs of
implementing those sections will be paid from the new Toxic Exposures Fund (TEF) established by the Honoring our PACT Act. The TEF is a mandatory appropriation that the Department of
Veterans Affairs will use to pay for health care, disability claims processing, medical research, and information technology modernization to benefit veterans who have been exposed to
environmental hazards. CBO expects that additional spending from the TEF will occur because this act increases costs of similar activities that benefit veterans with such exposures. The costs
of the sections that will be paid from the TEF are classified as direct spending and thus are included in this estimate.
